Dead candidates are normally only marked (NaN bound, no\n// synchronisation needed since every thread owns fixed positions); the list\n// is compacted (order-preserving) once less than half of it is live.\n// A float test (with a rigorous error bound) proves cheaply that a new\n// member does not increase a candidate's max distance; otherwise the exact\n// double computation is done, so all decisions are exact.\ntemplate <int BLOCK>\n__device__ int blockCluster(const DeviceData& D, const int seed, const int slot, int* out) {\n    constexpr int NWARPS = BLOCK / 32;\n    constexpr int UNROLL = 4;\n    __shared__ int s_cnt[2][NWARPS];\n    __shared__ double s_red_s[2][NWARPS];\n    __shared__ int s_red_i[2][NWARPS];\n    __shared__ int s_red_n[2][NWARPS];\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int lane = tid & 31;\n    const int warp = tid >> 5;\n    const unsigned lt_mask = (1u << lane) - 1u;\n    const size_t so = static_cast<size_t>(slot) * D.max_m;\n    float4* __restrict__ sH = D.s_hot + so;\n    double* __restrict__ sX = D.s_x + so;\n    double* __restrict__ sY = D.s_y + so;\n    double* __restrict__ sD = D.s_d2 + so;\n    const double T = D.T;\n    const float E = D.E;\n\n    const double2 ps = D.pts[seed];\n    const bool use_list = D.nbr_off != nullptr;\n    const int begin = use_list ? D.nbr_off[seed] : 0;\n    const int end = use_list ? D.nbr_off[seed + 1] : D.N;\n\n    double best_d2 = CUDART_INF, best_s = CUDART_INF;\n    float best_f = CUDART_INF_F;\n    int best_i = NO_POINT;\n    int nlive = 0;  // live candidates owned by this thread\n\n    // Ordered block-wide append of kept elements; returns the new length.\n    auto blockAppend = [&](const bool keep, const int L, const int buf, int& pos) -> int {\n        const unsigned m = __ballot_sync(FULL_MASK, keep);\n        if (lane == 0) s_cnt[buf][warp] = __popc(m);\n        __syncthreads();\n        int woff = 0, tot = 0;\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int w = 0; w < NWARPS; ++w) {\n            const int v = s_cnt[buf][w];\n            woff += (w < warp) ? v : 0;\n            tot += v;\n        }\n        pos = L + woff + __popc(m & lt_mask);\n        return L + tot;\n    };\n\n    // Gather the live candidates (unclustered, within threshold of the seed).\n    int L = 0;\n    int buf = 0;\n    for (int base = begin; base < end; base += BLOCK, buf ^= 1) {\n        const int j = base + tid;\n        bool keep = false;\n        int c = -1;\n        double2 pc = make_double2(0.0, 0.0);\n        double d = 0.0;\n        if (j < end) {\n            c = use_list ? D.nbr_list[j] : j;\n            if (c != seed && !D.clustered[c]) {\n                pc = D.pts[c];\n                d = dist2(pc.x, pc.y, ps.x, ps.y);\n                keep = d <= T;\n            }\n        }\n        int pos;\n        L = blockAppend(keep, L, buf, pos);\n        if (keep) {\n            const float2 pf = D.ptsf[c];\n            sH[pos] = make_float4(pf.x, pf.y, __double2float_rd(d), __int_as_float(c));\n            sX[pos] = pc.x;\n            sY[pos] = pc.y;\n            sD[pos] = d;\n            considerCandidate(d, c, best_d2, best_s, best_f, best_i);\n            ++nlive;\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    if (out && tid == 0) out[0] = seed;\n    int count = 1;\n    int rb = 0;\n\n    while (true) {\n        // Block-wide argmin of (max_dist, index) and live count.\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int off = 16; D.nbr_list[j] : j;\n            if (c != seed && !D.clustered[c]) {\n                pf = D.ptsf[c];\n                v = dist2f(pf.x, pf.y, psf.x, psf.y);\n                // Neighbour lists hold exactly the points within threshold.\n                keep = use_list || (v <= 4.0f * D.T_hi + 4.0f * E && alive(v, c, seed));\n            }\n        }\n        const unsigned m = __ballot_sync(FULL_MASK, keep);\n        if (keep) {\n            const int pos = L + __popc(m & lt_mask);\n            *H(pos) = make_float4(pf.x, pf.y, v, __int_as_float(seed));\n            *I(pos) = c;\n            track(v, pos);\n            ++nlive;\n        }\n        L += __popc(m);\n    }\n    __syncwarp();\n\n    if (out && lane == 0) out[0] = seed;\n    int count = 1;\n\n    while (true) {\n        // Float pre-selection: the exact minimum is <= hmin = min(v + E), so\n        // only candidates with v - E <= hmin can be the closest point.\n        float hmin = v1 + E;\n        int total = nlive;\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int off = 16;  // extra slack, keeps ties inside\n\n        // Exact evaluation of the contenders: key (max_dist, position).\n        double best_s = CUDART_INF;\n        int best_j = NO_POINT;\n        auto evalExact = [&](const int j, const float4 h) {\n            const double s = sqrt(dist2(D.pts[*I(j)], D.pts[__float_as_int(h.w)]));\n            if (s < best_s || (s == best_s && j < best_j)) {\n                best_s = s;\n                best_j = j;\n            }\n        };\n        if (v1 - E <= cut) {\n            if (v2 - E <= cut) {\n                for (int j = lane; j < L; j += 32) {\n                    const float4 h = *H(j);\n                    if (h.z - E <= cut) evalExact(j, h);  // false for NaN\n                }\n            } else {\n                evalExact(j1, *H(j1));\n            }\n        }\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n            const double os = __shfl_xor_sync(FULL_MASK, best_s, off);\n            const int oj = __shfl_xor_sync(FULL_MASK, best_j, off);\n            if (os < best_s || (os == best_s && oj < best_j)) {\n                best_s = os;\n                best_j = oj;\n            }\n        }\n\n        const int pj = best_j;\n        const float4 ph = *H(pj);\n        const int p = *I(pj);\n        if (out && lane == 0) out[count] = p;\n        ++count;\n\n        const bool compact = 2 * total < L && L > 64;\n        v1 = v2 = CUDART_INF_F;\n        j1 = NO_POINT;\n        nlive = 0;\n\n        // Add p: update the max distance (and its member) of candidate j\n        // with entry h. Returns false if the candidate died.\n        auto update = [&](const int j, float4& h, bool& changed) -> bool {\n            const float d2f = dist2f(h.x, h.y, ph.x, ph.y);\n            changed = false;\n            if (d2f + E < h.z - E) {\n                // max unchanged\n            } else if (d2f - E > h.z + E) {\n                changed = true;\n            } else {\n                const double2 pc = D.pts[*I(j)];\n                changed = dist2(pc, D.pts[p]) > dist2(pc, D.pts[__float_as_int(h.w)]);\n            }\n            if (changed) {\n                h.z = d2f;\n                h.w = __int_as_float(p);\n            }\n            return alive(h.z, *I(j), __float_as_int(h.w));\n        };\n\n        if (!compact) {\n            // Update in place; every lane owns positions lane + 32k.\n            for (int j = lane; j < L; j += 32) {\n                float4 h = *H(j);\n                if (h.z != h.z) continue;  // dead\n                float* hz = reinterpret_cast<float*>(H(j)) + 2;\n                if (j == pj) {\n                    *hz = CUDART_NAN_F;\n                    continue;\n                }\n                bool changed;\n                if (!update(j, h, changed)) {\n                    *hz = CUDART_NAN_F;\n                    continue;\n                }\n                if (changed) *H(j) = h;\n                track(h.z, j);\n                ++nlive;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Update and compact (order preserving, in place).\n            int newL = 0;\n            for (int base = 0; base < L; base += 32) {\n                const int j = base + lane;\n                bool keep = false;\n                float4 h = make_float4(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f);\n                int c = -1;\n                if (j < L) {\n                    h = *H(j);\n                    if (h.z == h.z && j != pj) {\n                        bool changed;\n                        keep = update(j, h, changed);\n                        c = *I(j);\n                    }\n                }\n                const unsigned m = __ballot_sync(FULL_MASK, keep);\n                if (keep) {\n                    const int pos = newL + __popc(m & lt_mask);\n                    *H(pos) = h;\n                    *I(pos) = c;\n                    track(h.z, pos);\n                    ++nlive;\n                }\n                newL += __popc(m);\n            }\n            L = newL;\n        }\n        __syncwarp();\n    }\n    return count;\n}\n\n// Number of other points within threshold of each point.\n__global__ void countNeighborsKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts, const int N,\n                                     const double T, int* __restrict__ counts) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N) return;\n    const double2 pi = pts[i];\n    int cnt = 0;\n    for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)\n        if (j != i && dist2(pts[j], pi) <= T) ++cnt;\n    counts[i] = cnt;\n}\n\n// Fill CSR neighbour lists (ascending index order).\n__global__ void fillNeighborsKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts, const int N,\n                                    const double T, const int* __restrict__ off,\n                                    int* __restrict__ list) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N) return;\n    const double2 pi = pts[i];\n    int w = off[i];\n    for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)\n        if (j != i && dist2(pts[j], pi) <= T) list[w++] = j;\n}\n\n// Best seed among those whose cached cardinality is valid.\n__global__ void selectBestValidKernel(const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                      const unsigned char* __restrict__ valid,\n                                      const int* __restrict__ card, const int N,\n                                      unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i < N && !clustered[i] && valid[i]) atomicMax(best_key, seedKey(card[i], i));\n}\n\n// Seeds without a valid cardinality whose upper bound could still beat the\n// best known exact candidate cluster.\n__global__ void gatherCandidatesKernel(const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                       const unsigned char* __restrict__ valid,\n                                       const int* __restrict__ ub, const int N,\n                                       const unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key,\n                                       int* __restrict__ keys, int* __restrict__ vals,\n                                       int* __restrict__ count) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N || clustered[i] || valid[i]) return;\n    const int u = ub[i];\n    if (seedKey(u, i) > *best_key) {\n        const int pos = atomicAdd(count, 1);\n        keys[pos] = u;\n        vals[pos] = i;\n    }\n}\n\n// Exact candidate cluster cardinalities for a list of seeds (one warp per\n// seed, sorted by decreasing upper bound). Seeds whose upper bound cannot\n// beat the best cluster found so far are skipped (they stay invalid).\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(SEED_WARPS * 32)\ncomputeCardinalityKernel(const DeviceData D, const int* __restrict__ seeds, const int n,\n                         int* __restrict__ work_counter, int* __restrict__ card,\n                         const int* __restrict__ ub, unsigned char* __restrict__ valid,\n                         unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key,\n                         int* __restrict__ member_store) {\n    extern __shared__ float4 dyn_smem[];\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n    float4* sh_hot = dyn_smem + static_cast<size_t>(warp) * D.smem_cap;\n    int* sh_idx = reinterpret_cast<int*>(dyn_smem + static_cast<size_t>(SEED_WARPS) * D.smem_cap) +\n                  static_cast<size_t>(warp) * D.smem_cap;\n    const size_t slot = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * SEED_WARPS + warp;\n    while (true) {\n        int i = 0, skip = 0;\n        if (lane == 0) {\n            i = atomicAdd(work_counter, 1);\n            if (i < n) {\n                const int s = seeds[i];\n                skip = seedKey(ub[s], s) <\n                       *reinterpret_cast<volatile unsigned long long*>(best_key);\n            }\n        }\n        i = __shfl_sync(FULL_MASK, i, 0);\n        skip = __shfl_sync(FULL_MASK, skip, 0);\n        if (i >= n) break;\n        if (skip) continue;\n        const int s = seeds[i];\n        int* out = member_store ? member_store + D.nbr_off[s] + s : nullptr;\n        const int c = warpCluster(D, s, slot, out, sh_hot, sh_idx);\n        if (lane == 0) {\n            card[s] = c;\n            valid[s] = 1;\n            atomicMax(best_key, seedKey(c, s));\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Rebuild the winning cluster (one warp), record members, mark clustered.\n__global__ void recordClusterKernel(const DeviceData D,\n                                    const unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key,\n                                    unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                    int* __restrict__ out) {\n    extern __shared__ float4 dyn_smem[];\n    int* sh_idx = reinterpret_cast<int*>(dyn_smem + D.smem_cap);\n    const int seed = keySeed(*best_key);\n    const int cnt = warpCluster(D, seed, 0, out, dyn_smem, sh_idx);\n    __syncwarp();\n    for (int k = threadIdx.x; k < cnt; k += 32) clustered[out[k]] = 1;\n}\n\n// Copy the stored members of the winning cluster and mark them clustered.\n__global__ void copyClusterKernel(const int* __restrict__ nbr_off,\n                                  const int* __restrict__ member_store,\n                                  const unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key,\n                                  unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                  int* __restrict__ out) {\n    const unsigned long long key = *best_key;\n    const int seed = keySeed(key);\n    const int cnt = static_cast<int>(key >> 32);\n    const int* src = member_store + nbr_off[seed] + seed;\n    for (int k = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; k < cnt; k += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {\n        const int m = src[k];\n        out[k] = m;\n        clustered[m] = 1;\n    }\n}\n\n// Seeds with a newly clustered point within threshold lose their cached\n// cardinality (walk the neighbours of each new member).\n__global__ void markDirtyCSRKernel(const int* __restrict__ nbr_off,\n                                   const int* __restrict__ nbr_list,\n                                   const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                   const int* __restrict__ new_members,\n                                   const unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key,\n                                   unsigned char* __restrict__ valid,\n                                   unsigned char* __restrict__ dirty) {\n    const int cnt = static_cast<int>(*best_key >> 32);\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const int nwarps = (gridDim.x * blockDim.x) >> 5;\n    for (int k = (blockIdx.x * blockDim.x +       if (!clustered[s]) {\n                valid[s] = 0;\n                dirty[s] = 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Upper bound grid: a candidate cluster has diameter < threshold, so in any\n// rotated frame it fits into a square of side threshold containing the seed.\n// Live neighbours are binned into cells of side threshold/UB_G around the\n// seed; any such square is covered by UB_B x UB_B cells (one cell of slack\n// for rounding), so the largest such cell block count bounds the cluster.\nstatic constexpr int UB_G = 16;\nstatic constexpr int UB_B = UB_G + 2;\nstatic constexpr int UB_NC = 2 * UB_B;     // cells per dimension\nstatic constexpr int UB_OFF = UB_B;        // cell of the seed\nstatic constexpr int UB_WARPS = 4;         // warps per block\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ int ubCell(const double t) {\n    const double f = floor(t) + UB_OFF;\n    return f < 0.0 ? 0 : (f > UB_NC - 1 ? UB_NC - 1 : static_cast<int>(f));\n}\n\n// Inclusive 2D prefix sums of a UB_NC x UB_NC histogram, then the maximum\n// count over cell blocks of UB_B x UB_B cells containing the seed cell.\n__device__ int ubMaxBlock(int* h, const int lane) {\n    __syncwarp();\n    for (int r = lane; r < UB_NC; r += 32)\n        for (int c = 1; c < UB_NC; ++c) h[r * UB_NC + c] += h[r * UB_NC + c - 1];\n    __syncwarp();\n    for (int c = lane; c < UB_NC; c += 32)\n        for (int r = 1; r < UB_NC; ++r) h[r * UB_NC + c] += h[(r - 1) * UB_NC + c];\n    __syncwarp();\n    int best = 0;\n    for (int k = lane; k < UB_B * UB_B; k += 32) {\n        const int r0 = UB_OFF - UB_B + 1 + k / UB_B;  // >= 1\n        const int c0 = UB_OFF - UB_B + 1 + k % UB_B;\n        const int r1 = r0 + UB_B - 1;                 // <= UB_NC - 1\n        const int c1 = c0 + UB_B - 1;\n        const int v = h[r1 * UB_NC + c1] - h[(r0 - 1) * UB_NC + c1] -\n                      h[r1 * UB_NC + c0 - 1] + h[(r0 - 1) * UB_NC + c0 - 1];\n        best = max(best, v);\n    }\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) best = max(best, __shfl_xor_sync(FULL_MASK, best, off));\n    return best;\n}\n\n// Recompute the cardinality upper bound of dirty seeds (one warp per seed):\n// 1 + live neighbours, tightened by the grid bound when enabled.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(UB_WARPS * 32)\nupdateUpperBoundKernel(const int* __restrict__ nbr_off, const int* __restrict__ nbr_list,\n                       const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                       const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered, const int N,\n                       const double inv_cell, const bool use_grid,\n                       unsigned char* __restrict__ dirty, int* __restrict__ ub) {\n    __shared__ int s_hist[UB_WARPS][2][UB_NC * UB_NC];\n    const int i = (blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x) >> 5;\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    if (i >= N || !dirty[i]) return;\n    int* h0 = s_hist[threadIdx.x >> 5][0];\n    int* h1 = s_hist[threadIdx.x >> 5][1];\n    if (use_grid)\n        for (int k = lane; k < UB_NC * UB_NC; k += 32) h0[k] = h1[k] = 0;\n    __syncwarp();\n    const double2 ps = pts[i];\n    const double rs = 0.70710678118654752440 * inv_cell;\n    int cnt = 0;\n    for (int j = nbr_off[i] + lane; j < nbr_off[i + 1]; j += 32) {\n        const int c = nbr_list[j];\n        if (clustered[c]) atomicAdd(&h0[ubCell(dy * inv_cell) * UB_NC + ubCell(dx * inv_cell)], 1);\n            atomicAdd(&h1[ubCell((dy - dx) * rs) * UB_NC + ubCell((dx + dy) * rs)], 1);\n        }\n    }\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) cnt += __shfl_xor_sync(FULL_MASK, cnt, off);\n    if (use_grid) cnt = min(cnt, min(ubMaxBlock(h0, lane), ubMaxBlock(h1, lane)));\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        ub[i] = cnt + 1;\n        dirty[i] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Fallback without neighbour lists: scan the new members for every seed.\n__global__ void markDirtyScanKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                                    const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered, const int N,\n                                    const double T, const int* __restrict__ new_members,\n                                    const unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key,\n                                    unsigned char* __restrict__ valid) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N || clustered[i] || !valid[i]) return;\n    const int cnt = static_cast<int>(*best_key >> 32);\n    const double2 pi = pts[i];\n    for (int k = 0; k < cnt; ++k) {\n        if (dist2(pi, pts[new_members[k]]) <= T) {\n            valid[i] = 0;\n            return;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Largest double T with sqrt(T) < threshold (sqrt is correctly rounded on\n// both host and device, so this is exact).\nstatic double squaredThresholdBound(const double threshold) {\n    double t = threshold * threshold;\n    while (t > 0.0 && !(std::sqrt(t) < threshold)) t = std::nextafter(t, 0.0);\n    while (true) {\n        const double nt = std::nextafter(t, std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity());\n        if (nt == t || !(std::sqrt(nt) < threshold)) break;\n        t = nt;\n    }\n    return t;\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N == 0) return clusters;\n\n    const double T = squaredThresholdBound(threshold);\n    const int TPB = 256;\n    const int nblk = (N + TPB - 1) / TPB;\n\n    int device = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device));\n    cudaDeviceProp prop;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop, device));\n\n    // Points (double for exact arithmetic, float for the fast paths)\n    std::vector<double2> hpts(N);\n    std::vector<float2> hptsf(N);\n    double max_coord = 0.0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        hpts[i] = make_double2(points[i].x, points[i].y);\n        hptsf[i] = make_float2(static_cast<float>(points[i].x), static_cast<float>(points[i].y));\n        max_coord = std::max({max_coord, std::fabs(points[i].x), std::fabs(points[i].y)});\n    }\n    double2* d_pts;\n    float2* d_ptsf;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_pts, sizeof(double2) * N));\n sizeof(float2) * N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    // Error bound of the float squared distance between two points within\n    // threshold of a common seed (|dx|, |dy| < 2*thr), generously inflated.\n    // If it is not finite the exact path is always taken.\n    float E_bound = std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity();\n    {\n        const double u = std::ldexp(1.0, -24);\n        const double dmax = 2.0 * std::sqrt(T);\n        const double delta = (2.0 * max_coord + dmax) * u * 2.0;  // |dxf - dx|\n        const double e = 2.0 * delta * (2.0 * dmax + delta) +\n                         8.0 * u * (dmax + delta) * (dmax + delta);\n        const double eb = 4.0 * e + 1e-30;\n        if (std::isfinite(eb) && eb < 1e30) E_bound = static_cast<float>(eb);\n    }\n    float T_lo = static_cast<float>(T), T_hi = T_lo;\n    if (static_cast<double>(T_lo) > T) T_lo = std::nextafter(T_lo, 0.0f);\n    if (static_cast<double>(T_hi) < T)\n        T_hi = std::nextafter(T_hi, cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize,\n                                    static_cast<int>(smem)));\n    int per_sm = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(\n        &per_sm, computeCardinalityKernel, SEED_WARPS * 32, smem));\n    long long cgrid = static_cast<long long>(std::max(per_sm, 1)) * prop.multiProcessorCount;\n\n    // Global scratch per warp for CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_mem, &total_mem));\n        const long long mem_blocks = static_cast<long long>(\n            (free_mem / 2) / (entry_bytes * max_m * SEED_WARPS));\n        cgrid = CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_dirty, N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_card, sizeof(int) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_ub, sizeof(int) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_work, sizeof(int)));\n A rigorous error bound E turns the float values\n//    into exact intervals; whenever an interval cannot decide a comparison\n//    (rare) the exact double value is computed, evaluated exactly like the\n//    host version of distance().  // warps (= concurrent seeds) per block\n\n// Exact squared distance, evaluated exactly like the host build of\n// distance() (dy*dy rounded, then fused multiply-add of dx*dx).\n__device__ __forceinline__ double dist2(const double2 a, const double2 b) {\n    const double dx = a.x - b.x;\n    const double dy = a.y - b.y;\n    return __fma_rn(dx, dx, __dmul_rn(dy, dy));\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float dist2f(const float ax, const float ay, const float bx,\n                                        const float by) {\n    const float dx = ax - bx;\n    const float dy = ay - by;\n    return dx * dx + dy * dy;\n}\n\n// Sort key of a seed: larger cardinality first, then lower index.\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ unsigned long long seedKey(const int card, const int idx) {\n    return (static_cast<unsigned long long>(static_cast<unsigned>(card)) << 32) |\n           static_cast<unsigned long long>(0xffffffffu - static_cast<unsigned>(idx));\n}\n\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int keySeed(const unsigned long long key) {\n    return static_cast<int>(0xffffffffu - static_cast<unsigned>(key & 0xffffffffull));\n}\n\nstruct DeviceData {\n    const double2* pts;\n    const float2* ptsf;   // float copies of the coordinates\n    const unsigned char* clustered;\n    const int* nbr_off;   // CSR neighbour lists (nullptr -> scan all points)\n    const int* nbr_list;\n    int N;\n    double T;             // largest d2 with sqrt(d2) < threshold\n    float T_lo, T_hi;     // float bounds of T\n    float E;              // bound on |float d2 - exact d2| for candidate pairs\n    int max_m;            // max neighbour count (scratch capacity per warp)\n    int smem_cap;         // candidate entries kept in shared memory per warp\n    float4* g_hot;        // global scratch beyond smem_cap, max_m per warp\n    int* g_idx;\n};\n\n// Build the candidate cluster of `seed` with one warp. Returns its\n// cardinality; if `out` is given, members are written in insertion order.\n//\n// Live candidates are kept in ascending index order (so position order\n// equals index order for tie-breaking) as {x, y, v, m} plus the point index,\n// where m is the member attaining the max distance and v the float squared\n// distance to it: the exact max d2 lies in [v - E, v + E]. The first\n// `smem_cap` entries live in shared memory, the rest in global scratch.\n// Dead candidates are marked (v = NaN); the list is compacted (order\n// preserving) once less than half of it is live.\n__device__ int warpCluster(const DeviceData& D, const int seed, const size_t slot, int* out,\n                           float4* sh_hot, int* sh_idx) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const unsigned lt_mask = (1u << lane) - 1u;\n    const int C = D.smem_cap;\n    float4* const gH = D.g_hot ? D.g_hot + slot * D.max_m : nullptr;\n    int* const gI = D.g_idx ? D.g_idx + slot * D.max_m : nullptr;\n    auto H = [&](const int j) -> float4* { return j < C ? sh_hot + j : gH + j; };\n    auto I = [&](const int j) -> int* { return j < C ? sh_idx + j : gI + j; };\n    const float E = D.E;\n\n    // Per-lane two smallest v (v1 at position j1) among live candidates.\n    float v1 = CUDART_INF_F, v2 = CUDART_INF_F;\n    int j1 = NO_POINT;\n    int nlive = 0;\n    auto track = [&](const float v, const int j) {\n        if (v < v1) {\n            v2 = v1;\n            v1 = v;\n            j1 = j;\n        } else if (v < v2) {\n            v2 = v;\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Exact \"max d2 <= T\" for max d2 in [v - E, v + E] attained by member m.\n    auto alive = [&](const float v, const int c, const int m) -> bool {\n        if (v - E > D.T_hi) return false;\n        if (v + E <= D.T_lo) return true;\n        return dist2(D.pts[c], D.pts[m]) <= D.T;\n    };\n\n    // Gather the live candidates (unclustered, within threshold of the seed).\n    const float2 psf = D.ptsf[seed];\n    const bool use_list = D.nbr_off != nullptr;\n    const int begin = use_list ? D.nbr_off[seed] : 0;\n    const int end = use_list ? D.nbr_off[seed + 1] : D.N;\n    int L = 0;\n    for (int base = begin; base < end; base += 32) {\n        const int j = base + lane;\n        bool keep = false;\n        int c = -1;\n        float2 pf = make_float2(0.f, 0.f);\n        float v = 0.f;\n        if (j < end) {\n            c = use_list ? D.nbr_list[j] : j;\n            if (c != seed && !D.clustered[c]) {\n                pf = D.ptsf[c];\n                v = dist2f(pf.x, pf.y, psf.x, psf.y);\n                // Neighbour lists hold exactly the points within threshold.\n                keep = use_list || (v <= 4.0f * D.T_hi + 4.0f * E && alive(v, c, seed));\n            }\n        }\n        const unsigned m = __ballot_sync(FULL_MASK, keep);\n        if (keep) {\n            const int pos = L + __popc(m & lt_mask);\n            *H(pos) = make_float4(pf.x, pf.y, v, __int_as_float(seed));\n            *I(pos) = c;\n            track(v, pos);\n            ++nlive;\n        }\n        L += __popc(m);\n    }\n    __syncwarp();\n\n    if (out && lane == 0) out[0] = seed;\n    int count = 1;\n\n    while (true) {\n        // Float pre-selection: the exact minimum is <= hmin = min(v + E), so\n        // only candidates with v - E <= hmin can be the closest point.\n        float hmin = v1 + E;\n        int total = nlive;\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n            hmin = fminf(hmin, __shfl_xor_sync(FULL_MASK, hmin, off));\n            total += __shfl_xor_sync(FULL_MASK, total, off);\n        }\n        if (total == 0) break;  // no point can be added\n        const float cut = hmin + E;  // extra slack, keeps ties inside\n\n        // Exact evaluation of the contenders: key (max_dist, position).\n        double best_s = CUDART_INF;\n        int best_j = NO_POINT;\n        auto evalExact = [&](const int j, const float4 h) {\n            const double s = sqrt(dist2(D.pts[*I(j)], D.pts[__float_as_int(h.w)]));\n            if (s < best_s || (s == best_s && j < best_j)) {\n                best_s = s;\n                best_j = j;\n            }\n        };\n        if (v1 - E <= cut) {\n            if (v2 - E <= cut) {\n                for (int j = lane; j < L; j += 32) {\n                    const float4 h = *H(j);\n                    if (h.z - E <= cut) evalExact(j, h);  // false for NaN\n                }\n            } else {\n                evalExact(j1, *H(j1));\n            }\n        }\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n            const double os = __shfl_xor_sync(FULL_MASK, best_s, off);\n            const int oj = __shfl_xor_sync(FULL_MASK, best_j, off);\n            if (os < best_s || (os == best_s && oj < best_j)) {\n                best_s = os;\n                best_j = oj;\n            }\n        }\n\n        const int pj = best_j;\n        const float4 ph = *H(pj);\n        const int p = *I(pj);\n        if (out && lane == 0) out[count] = p;\n        ++count;\n\n        const bool compact = 2 * total < L && L > 64;\n        v1 = v2 = CUDART_INF_F;\n        j1 = NO_POINT;\n        nlive = 0;\n\n        // Add p: update the max distance (and its member) of candidate j\n        // with entry h. Returns false if the candidate died.\n        auto update = [&](const int j, float4& h, bool& changed) -> bool {\n            const float d2f = dist2f(h.x, h.y, ph.x, ph.y);\n            changed = false;\n            if (d2f + E < h.z - E) {\n                // max unchanged\n            } else if (d2f - E > h.z + E) {\n                changed = true;\n            } else {\n                const double2 pc = D.pts[*I(j)];\n                changed = dist2(pc, D.pts[p]) > dist2(pc, D.pts[__float_as_int(h.w)]);\n            }\n            if (changed) {\n                h.z = d2f;\n                h.w = __int_as_float(p);\n            }\n            return alive(h.z, *I(j), __float_as_int(h.w));\n        };\n\n        if (!compact) {\n            // Update in place; every lane owns positions lane + 32k.\n            for (int j = lane; j < L; j += 32) {\n                float4 h = *H(j);\n                if (h.z != h.z) continue;  // dead\n                float* hz = reinterpret_cast<float*>(H(j)) + 2;\n                if (j == pj) {\n                    *hz = CUDART_NAN_F;\n                    continue;\n                }\n                bool changed;\n                if (!update(j, h, changed)) {\n                    *hz = CUDART_NAN_F;\n                    continue;\n                }\n                if (changed) *H(j) = h;\n                track(h.z, j);\n                ++nlive;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Update and compact (order preserving, in place).\n            int newL = 0;\n            for (int base = 0; base < L; base += 32) {\n                const int j = base + lane;\n                bool keep = false;\n                float4 h = make_float4(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f);\n                int c = -1;\n                if (j < L) {\n                    h = *H(j);\n                    if (h.z == h.z && j != pj) {\n                        bool changed;\n                        keep = update(j, h, changed);\n                        c = *I(j);\n                    }\n                }\n                const unsigned m = __ballot_sync(FULL_MASK, keep);\n                if (keep) {\n                    const int pos = newL + __popc(m & lt_mask);\n                    *H(pos) = h;\n                    *I(pos) = c;\n                    track(h.z, pos);\n                    ++nlive;\n                }\n                newL += __popc(m);\n            }\n            L = newL;\n        }\n        __syncwarp();\n    }\n    return count;\n}\n\n// Number of other points within threshold of each point.\n__global__ void countNeighborsKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts, const int N,\n                                     const double T, int* __restrict__ counts) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N) return;\n    const double2 pi = pts[i];\n    int cnt = 0;\n    for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)\n        if (j != i && dist2(pts[j], pi) <= T) ++cnt;\n    counts[i] = cnt;\n}\n\n// Fill CSR neighbour lists (ascending index order).\n__global__ void fillNeighborsKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts, const int N,\n                                    const double T, const int* __restrict__ off,\n                                    int* __restrict__ list) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N) return;\n    const double2 pi = pts[i];\n    int w = off[i];\n    for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)\n        if (j != i && dist2(pts[j], pi) <= T) list[w++] = j;\n}\n\n// Best seed among those whose cached cardinality is valid.\n__global__ void selectBestValidKernel(const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                      const unsigned char* __restrict__ valid,\n                                      const int* __restrict__ card, const int N,\n                                      unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i < N && !clustered[i] && valid[i]) atomicMax(best_key, seedKey(card[i], i));\n}\n\n// Seeds without a valid cardinality whose upper bound could still beat the\n// best known exact candidate cluster.\n__global__ void gatherCandidatesKernel(const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                       const unsigned char* __restrict__ valid,\n                                       const int* __restrict__ ub, const int N,\n                                       const unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key,\n                                       int* __restrict__ keys, int* __restrict__ vals,\n                                       int* __restrict__ count) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N || clustered[i] || valid[i]) return;\n    const int u = ub[i];\n    if (seedKey(u, i) > *best_key) {\n        const int pos = atomicAdd(count, 1);\n        keys[pos] = u;\n        vals[pos] = i;\n    }\n}\n\n// Exact candidate cluster cardinalities for a list of seeds (one warp per\n// seed, sorted by decreasing upper bound). Seeds whose upper bound cannot\n// beat the best cluster found so far are skipped (they stay invalid).\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(SEED_WARPS * 32)\ncomputeCardinalityKernel(const DeviceData D, const int* __restrict__ seeds, const int n,\n                         int* __restrict__ work_counter, int* __restrict__ card,\n                         const int* __restrict__ ub, unsigned char* __restrict__ valid,\n                         unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key,\n                         int* __restrict__ member_store) {\n    extern __shared__ float4 dyn_smem[];\n s));\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Rebuild the winning cluster (one warp), record members, mark clustered.\n__global__ void recordClusterKernel(const DeviceData D,\n __shared__ float4 dyn_smem[];\n    int* sh_idx = reinterpret_cast<int*>(dyn_smem + D.smem_cap);\n    const int seed = keySeed(*best_key);\n    const int cnt = warpCluster(D, seed, 0, out, dyn_smem, copyClusterKernel(const int* __restrict__ nbr_off,\n                                  const int* __restrict__ member_store,\n                                  const unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key,\n                                  unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                  int* __restrict__ out) {\n    const unsigned long long key = *best_key;\n cached\n// cardinality (walk the neighbours of each new member).\n__global__ void markDirtyCSRKernel(const int* __restrict__ nbr_off,\n                                   const int* __restrict__ nbr_list,\n                                   const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                   const int* __restrict__ new_members,\n                                   const unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key,\n                                   unsigned char* __restrict__ valid,\n                                   unsigned char* __restrict__ dirty) {\n       if (!clustered[s]) {\n                valid[s] = 0;\n                dirty[s] = 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Upper bound grid: a candidate cluster has diameter < threshold, so in any\n// rotated frame it fits into a square of side threshold containing the seed.\n// Live neighbours are binned into cells of side threshold/UB_G around the\n// seed; any such square is covered by UB_B x UB_B cells (one cell of slack\n// for rounding), so the largest such cell block count bounds the cluster.\nstatic constexpr int UB_G = 16;\nstatic constexpr int UB_B = UB_G + 2;\nstatic constexpr int UB_NC = 2 * UB_B;     // cells per dimension\nstatic constexpr int UB_OFF = UB_B;        // cell of the seed\nstatic constexpr int UB_WARPS = 4;         // warps per block\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ int ubCell(const double t) {\n    const double f = floor(t) + UB_OFF;\n    return f < 0.0 ? 0 : (f > UB_NC - 1 ? UB_NC - 1 : static_cast<int>(f));\n}\n\n// Inclusive 2D prefix sums of a UB_NC x UB_NC histogram, then the maximum\n// count over cell blocks of UB_B x UB_B cells containing the seed cell.\n__device__ int ubMaxBlock(int* h, const int lane) {\n    __syncwarp();\n    for (int r = lane; r < UB_NC; r += 32)\n        for (int c = 1; c < UB_NC; ++c) h[r * UB_NC + c] += h[r * UB_NC + c - 1];\n    __syncwarp();\n    for (int c = lane; c < UB_NC; c += 32)\n        for (int r = 1; r < UB_NC; ++r) h[r * UB_NC + c] += h[(r - 1) * UB_NC + c];\n    __syncwarp();\n    int best = 0;\n    for (int k = lane; k < UB_B * UB_B; k += 32) {\n        const int r0 = UB_OFF - UB_B + 1 + k / UB_B;  // >= 1\n        const int c0 = UB_OFF - UB_B + 1 + k % UB_B;\n        const int r1 = r0 + UB_B - 1; c0 - 1];\n        best = max(best, v);\n    }\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) best = max(best, __shfl_xor_sync(FULL_MASK, best, off));\n    return best;\n}\n\n// Recompute the cardinality upper bound of dirty seeds (one warp per seed):\n// 1 + live neighbours, tightened by the grid bound when enabled.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(UB_WARPS * 32)\nupdateUpperBoundKernel(const int* __restrict__ nbr_off, const int* __restrict__ nbr_list,\n                       const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                       const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered, const int N,\n                       const double inv_cell, const bool use_grid,\n                       unsigned char* __restrict__ dirty, int* __restrict__ ub) {\n    __shared__ int s_hist[UB_WARPS][2][UB_NC * UB_NC];\n    const int i = (blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x) >> 5;\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    if (i >= N || !dirty[i]) return;\n    int* h0 = s_hist[threadIdx.x >> 5][0];\n    int* h1 = s_hist[threadIdx.x >> 5][1];\n    if (use_grid)\n        for (int k = lane; k < UB_NC * UB_NC; k += 32) h0[k] = h1[k] = 0;\n    __syncwarp();\n    const double2 ps = pts[i];\n    const atomicAdd(&h0[ubCell(dy * inv_cell) * UB_NC + ubCell(dx * inv_cell)], 1);\n            atomicAdd(&h1[ubCell((dy - dx) * rs) * UB_NC + ubCell((dx + dy) * rs)], 1);\n        }\n    }\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) cnt += __shfl_xor_sync(FULL_MASK, cnt, off);\n    if (use_grid) cnt = min(cnt, min(ubMaxBlock(h0, lane), ubMaxBlock(h1, lane)));\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        ub[i] = cnt + 1;\n        dirty[i] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Fallback without neighbour lists: scan the new members for every seed.\n__global__ void markDirtyScanKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                                    const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered, const int N,\n                                    const double T, const int* __restrict__ new_members,\n                                    const unsigned long long* __restrict__ best_key,\n                                    unsigned char* __restrict__ valid) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N || clustered[i] || !valid[i]) return;\n    const int cnt = static_cast<int>(*best_key >> 32);\n    const double2 pi = pts[i];\n    for (int k = 0; k < cnt; ++k) {\n        if (dist2(pi, pts[new_members[k]]) <= T) {\n            valid[i] = 0;\n            return;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Largest double T with sqrt(T) < threshold (sqrt is correctly rounded on\n// both host and device, so this is exact).\nstatic double squaredThresholdBound(const double threshold) {\n    double t = threshold * threshold;\n    while (t > 0.0 && !(std::sqrt(t) < threshold)) t = std::nextafter(t, 0.0);\n    while (true) {\n        const double nt = std::nextafter(t, std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity());\n        if (nt == t || !(std::sqrt(nt) < threshold)) break;\n        t = nt;\n    }\n    return t;\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N == 0) return clusters;\n\n    const double T = squaredThresholdBound(threshold);\n    const int TPB = 256;\n    const int nblk = (N + TPB - 1) / TPB;\n\n    int device = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device));\n    cudaDeviceProp prop;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop, device));\n\n    // Points (double for exact arithmetic, float for the fast paths)\n    std::vector<double2> hpts(N);\n    std::vector<float2> hptsf(N);\n    double max_coord = 0.0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        hpts[i] = make_double2(points[i].x, points[i].y);\n        hptsf[i] = make_float2(static_cast<float>(points[i].x), static_cast<float>(points[i].y));\n        max_coord = std::max({max_coord, std::fabs(points[i].x), std::fabs(points[i].y)});\n    }\n    double2* d_pts;\n    float2* d_ptsf;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_pts, sizeof(double2) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_ptsf, sizeof(float2) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_pts, hpts.data(), sizeof(double2) * N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_ptsf, hptsf.data(), sizeof(float2) * N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    // Error bound of the float squared distance between two points within\n    // threshold of a common seed (|dx|, |dy| < 2*thr), generously inflated.\n    // If it is not finite the exact path is always taken.\n    float E_bound = std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity();\n    {\n        const double u = std::ldexp(1.0, -24);\n        const double dmax = 2.0 * std::sqrt(T);\n        const double delta = (2.0 * max_coord + dmax) * u * 2.0;  // |dxf - dx|\n        const double e = 2.0 * delta * (2.0 * dmax + delta) +\n                         8.0 * u * (dmax + delta) * (dmax + delta);\n        const double eb = 4.0 * e + 1e-30;\n        if (std::isfinite(eb) && eb < 1e30) E_bound = static_cast<float>(eb);\n    }\n    float T_lo = __restrict__ st,\n                                  unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                  int* __restrict__ members) {\n    if (st->offset >= N) return;\n    const + 1]; j += 32) {\n            const int s = nbr_list[j];\n            if (!clustered[s]) {\n                valid[s] = 0;\n                dirty[s] = 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Fallback without neighbour lists: scan the new members for every seed.\n__global__ void markDirtyScanKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                                    const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered, const int N,\n                                    const double T, const int* __restrict__ members,\n                                    const RoundState* __restrict__ st,\n                                    unsigned char* __restrict__ valid) {\n    if (st->offset >= N) return;\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N || clustered[i] || UB_NC = 2 * UB_B;     // cells per dimension\nstatic constexpr int UB_OFF = UB_B;        // cell of the seed\nstatic constexpr int UB_WARPS = 4;         // warps per block\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ int ubCell(const double t) {\n    const double f = floor(t) + UB_OFF;\n    return f < 0.0 ? 0 : (f > UB_NC - 1 ? UB_NC - 1 : static_cast<int>(f));\n}\n\n// Inclusive 2D prefix sums of a UB_NC x UB_NC histogram, then the maximum\n// count over cell blocks of UB_B x UB_B cells containing the seed cell.\n__device__ int ubMaxBlock(int* h, const int lane) {\n    __syncwarp();\n    for (int r = lane; r < UB_NC; r += 32)\n        for (int c = 1; c < UB_NC; ++c) h[r * UB_NC + c] += h[r * UB_NC + c - 1];\n    __syncwarp();\n    for (int c = lane; c < UB_NC; c += 32)\n        for (int r = 1; r < UB_NC; ++r) h[r * UB_NC + c] += h[(r - 1) * UB_NC + c];\n    __syncwarp();\n    int best = 0;\n    for (int k = c0 - 1];\n        best = max(best, v);\n    }\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) best = max(best, __shfl_xor_sync(FULL_MASK, best, off));\n    return best;\n}\n\n// Recompute the cardinality __restrict__ nbr_off, const int* __restrict__ nbr_list,\n                       const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                       const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered, const int N,\n                       const double inv_cell, const bool use_grid,\n                       const RoundState* __restrict__ st,\n                       unsigned char* __restrict__ dirty, int* __restrict__
